title: SKE Crystal Plus White Peach Prefilled Pods 20mg
description: Please Note: These pods are not compatible with the SKE BAR device. White Peach flavour SKE Crystal Plus prefilled pods deliver the delicate and natural sweetness of ripe white peaches, offering a smooth, refreshing, and subtly sweet vaping experience. Perfectly capturing the soft, mellow notes of this beloved stone fruit, White Peach is an ideal all-day vape for those who enjoy rich, clean and fragrant flavours. Designed for the SKE Crystal Plus Pod Kit, these prefilled pods ensure effortless vaping with no need for refills or maintenance. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, delivering a fast-acting and smoother throat hit compared to traditional freebase nicotine. Featuring an advanced 1.1ohm mesh coil, the White Peach pods produce consistently rich flavour and a satisfying mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping experience. With a prefilled, mess-free design, simply replace the pod when it’s empty and continue enjoying the smooth taste of White Peach. Please Note: SKE Crystal Plus pods include a protective seal that must be removed before use. Detach the bung from the top of the mouthpiece and allow the pod to sit for 5-10 minutes to ensure the coil is fully saturated with e-liquid, preventing dry hits or burnt coils
